name: Mobile core
kid: The mobile company’s control room. It checks your SIM card, unpacks your parcels from the tower’s tunnel and gives them an internet address.
nerd: The 5G core (5GC): AMF/SMF handle sign-in and sessions; the UPF ends the GTP-U tunnel, applies policy and does carrier-grade NAT towards the internet.

up.kid: The mobile core opens the tunnel envelope, then swaps your phone’s address and door number for its own, shared with lots of phones.
up.nerd: The UPF ends the GTP-U tunnel (by TEID), then carrier-grade NAT rewrites source address and port, fixes the checksums and routes on (TTL − 1).

down.kid: The mobile core looks up which phone asked, changes the address back and puts the parcel in the tunnel to the right tower.
down.nerd: CGNAT reverse (address and port from the mapping table), then the UPF tunnels it in GTP-U to the phone’s gNB (TEID).
